Full Patch Notes 1.4.0
New Features

The Most Wanted bounty hunting feature. Fulfill Most Wanted contracts, which can be found [spoiler]on the Most Wanted boards at the trading post, the Miner's headquarters, and in Corpse Creek[/spoiler].
'Light up the dark' questline with a new Biome: Snow Plains. This questline can be started at [spoiler]Shayan's candle-making station near the beehive in Kacheda Village, after you've completed the quests about gaining the pelt armor in the cold regions[/spoiler].


New Seasonal Decorations until January 10th
Make sure to go on adventures in Above Snakes until January 10th and collect Twinkle Stones (you will receive them at random by scavenging for resources). Collect enough of them to craft seasonal decorations that can no longer be crafted after that date! The crafted items will of course stay in your inventory.  Bounty hunter’s gear (reputation reward)
 Enhanced fishing rod (increases fishing speed)
 Tooth Necklace IV

New transition world pieces

 Prairie to Lake

New Achievements

Miscellaneous

 Wire is more common and can also be found at farms after Corpse Creek has been discovered.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/a3bedec345eae93210735efa542c0c0a0c9d8959.png
We are happy to release Above Snakes Patch 1.3.0 today!

It contains various improvements to the game, as well as the much requested Photo Mode, lots of new furniture alongside a playable piano, and more building parts!

Screenshot Contest

Participate on Twitter!
Participate on Discord!

 Playable piano: Craft a piano for your home that you can actually play!

New Placeable Items

 Stove (indoor cooking - highly requested) - Workbench Tier 3
 Piano (playable) - Workbench Tier 3

Balancing

 Fixed that sometimes quests did not complete (especially "You reap what you sow").

Supporter's Club
As announced in our previous update, we also set up a Supporter's Club if you want to support us beyond buying Above Snakes. Cheers,
Marc & Tobi

notes.title: Big Summer Update & 20% OFF!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/f3d087ac21583cc5d5a96d04f617f77eb0ef348d.png

New Game Mode: Exploration
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/58986a19bf46614c55b7848066b78a6bb350be17.png
We added a new game mode as an additional way to play Above Snakes. The existing mode that you know and love will still be available of course. From now on we will call the existing mode Adventure and the new mode Exploration.

What is different?
In short, Exploration mode offers:

A non-linear campaign - play through the stories in any order you desire or even in parallel!
Total freedom, you choose which biomes to unlock first.
Go on your own quests with your own goals in mind.
Resources to unlock new biomes are calculated dynamically on which ones you have access to.
Every journey can be different.
The tutorial is skipped (no Hunter's Rest).

Although this new mode is very exciting, we do highly recommend to play Adventure mode first (for at least 5-10 hours) before starting a journey in Exploration mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/479c664504bc10691ca11a46ee47780a47dd42fd.png

The untamed wilderness of Above Snakes becomes your playground! Begin your journey equipped with nothing more than a tent and a couple of tools with no immediate quest at hand. However, you might already harbor a personal quest, such as venturing out onto frozen lakes for a session of ice fishing. Alternatively, you may seek the vast deserts, seeking the legendary Rusty Remington from Mr. Jones. Perhaps your heart yearns to explore the forests, in pursuit of hunting with a bow that's built with the bowstring at Stark's cabin. The beauty of it all lies in your hands as you decide how to shape your journey and determine your objectives. Whatever you prefer to do first, however you want to play the game - the choice is yours!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/02f43521c11ce8cb6fc627b41bd0188e23422707.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/90b1fa0108bde02ff7fce45fe9f9eabc8e1c158c.png

We are sure, that this new mode offers many new possibilities and interesting ways how to survive in each biome. Every journey is different. All of the stories (except for Hunter's Rest) are still contained in the game and can be unlocked at the player's choice. Most of them reward you with a new feature or item that will help you with survival.

Mountains Biome (the Wildcard)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/26f95e494a9a6ee30902ce7ccb42380081828dd0.png
In response to multiple requests, we are introducing an exciting addition to your map building capabilities: the mountains biome. Acting as a versatile wildcard, this new biome can be seamlessly integrated into your map, serving as both fillers and connectors. Mountains can be placed in (almost) any location, adapting their edges to match the surrounding biomes to ensure a visually pleasing result.

Upgrade Buildings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/f23669b6c956e1dbaf82e0604fec7ccb2dd9d2f7.gif
Another feature that has been desired by many players is the ability to upgrade existing buildings from one style to another (e.g. log to plank), without the need to tear them down first and then to rebuild them. With this feature you can replace those parts in place! This building upgrade, as well as all other features and changes, are available in both the Adventure and Exploration modes.

In-Game Patch Notes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/1a70b0c6b269cdb9c4573575c61e6eca8c5c925f.png
You are now able to see patch notes and news about the game in the main menu of Above Snakes.

Other Improvements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/92160c9a3c1005ae8c0250e99bd0272cf63f9163.png
We also added a handful of quality of life improvements and bug fixes, such as item details being shown in storage chests.

20% Discount!
To celebrate the new update, Above Snakes is now 20% off until July 13.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1589120/Above_Snakes/

We hope you will enjoy the update and are as thrilled to play it as we are! :)
Let us know your thoughts in the comments below!

❤️ Please remember, if you play and enjoy the game please consider writing a Steam review.

---------

Patch Notes
New Features

 New Game Mode: Exploration Mode - Start a new game and choose the order of the story and the order of which biomes unlock!
 Upgrade Buildings - Instead of tearing a building down, you can use the hammer to upgrade each building part.
 Mountains biome (wildcard) - Unlock the mountains biome after discovering the trading post. Mountains fit everywhere and can be used to fill gaps.
 News Hub - Stay up to date with in-game Above Snakes news in the main menu.

New Content

 New world piece: Prairie / Corpse Creek.
 New world pieces: 2x Prairie / Canyons

Fixes

 Steam Deck: Items at merchants do not flow out of screen anymore.
 Storage chest: Added item details being shown.
 Projectile height is adjusted (aligns with weapon).
 Fixes translation for Ancient Key.
 Fixed that talking to the mayor was prohibited if Moonshine quest was not completed yet.
 Rework skeletons standing up during Mr. Jones quest.
 Fixed shown checkmarks for quests in quest dialogue when they are not cleared yet.
 Removed meteorite piece item from the game (had no purpose).
 Fixed that under certain circumstances Jeb did not provide The Hawk blueprint.
 Fixed that escaping the conversation with Bamey could lead to a soft lock.
 Fixed that Square Glade Club enrollment sometimes did not work and sometimes did not show Kickstarter rewards.

Balancing

 Patsy and Betsy quest is a little easier now.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 - Targeting in Combat, Crop Farming, Watchtower Events
notes.notes:
Combat - Targeting
We saw that many of you are not happy with the combat of the game. With this patch, we want to address one aspect of that: targeting. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/fb4f9198551739f2539bb02c78276693a577f4f8.gif


 Controller: Drastically improved auto-aim for ranged weapons. You no longer target random bushes or trees - only enemies, wildlife, and bees.
 Mouse: When using a range weapon you can not accidentally click on a tree and shoot in a completely wrong direction anymore. Trees are no longer targeted while using a ranged weapon.
 Mouse: When using a melee weapon, trees are only getting targeted at the trunk (up to roughly 1,5x player height).

Please be aware that this is the first of a series of improvements that we will make to combat, targeting and animations. We are not finished patching and adjusting.

Crop Farming
We realized that the crop farming mechanic was not as meaningful as it should be and that in many cases it was not worth investing your resources into a garden. We want to change that with this patch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/0b9d08e4bac7a554dc6504f1df8a713c83db5164.png


Drastically reduces grow times for crops. They grow faster.
Fertilizer and water hold for longer and they completely "fill" the garden with 1 use.
Fertilizer and water have more impact on growth speed.
Fertilizer and water now have an impact on the number of harvested crops.
Sleeping in bed skips time and lets plants grow.


Desert Watchtower Events

We understood that some of you found the watchtower events tedious and we want to address that. The number of enemies that spawned was bugged and in some cases (the longer you pushed the button, the more enemies spawned). Therefore way too many enemies were spawned. Additionally, it was a bug, that it was necessary to loot enemies (which caused sanity to decrease).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/8dbac1078f8638ae63ec716c31ad16c102d64161.png


The correct number of enemies spawn per watchtower event (2-3 enemies per wave).
Corrected the number of waves (always 3 waves).
It is no longer necessary to loot enemies to proceed.
Fixed that skeleton gunman sometimes took no damage.
Reduced sound volume of dynamite explosions.


Fixes

Some improvements to RAM management of the game. More improvements will follow.
Playstation controller: The correct interaction button for secondary interactions is shown ("circle").
Fixed wrong world piece icon of "Snow-covered forest / Forest"
Fixed that the world piece name was too big in some languages and overlapped the UI button.
Prevent character names below portraits to flow out of the screen (some languages had that issue).
Workbench UI: Fixed closing animation.
Korean: Buttons for opening files and subscribing to Square Glade Club are now readable.
You can no longer destroy the bonfire in Kacheda village with a hammer.
Fixed various spelling mistakes and translations.


❤️ If you enjoy the game please consider writing a Steam review. Reviews help especially small indie developers getting recognized by the algorithm.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Move Objects with your Hammer, Adjustments to Balancing and Fixes
notes.notes:
As promised, we are listening to player feedback and are happy to provide another patch with one of the most requested features: Being able to move objects by using the hammer, as well as some adjustments to balancing and fixes.

New Feature: Move Workstations, Furniture, Walls and Roofs without losing any resources!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/490461e87bc3b71536162acec54b5a43e4abd0f8.gif

 You can now move furniture, workstations, walls and roofs with your hammer instead of tearing them down, lose resources  and rebuilding them.


Balancing

 Workbench upgrade to V now requires 2 clay instead of 5.
 Story progress % is more accurate now. We now weight quests with a factor (how much effort they require) instead of just counting them. Before, the first part of the game added way too much % to the overall progress since the tutorial is packed with small quests.
 Increased spawn rate of wild carrots in prairie biome.
 Reduced health of penguins.


Fixes

 Fixed that you could lose your bow (or other items) when receiving the rusty rifle from Mr. Jones. (edit: this does not seem to be completely fixed)
 When trashing an equipped item, it is correctly unequipped now.
 When completing "A special Gift", the dead animal skull is correctly removed from inventory.
 After talking to Shayan, her written letter correctly disappears.
 Prevented building foundations underwater.
 Adjusted rarity of some quest items (Byrd's burner, Stark's parcel, Jeb's package).
 Prevented that Shayan can give the same quest twice.
 Corrected collider of sawmill in Hunter's Rest.
 Fixed that you were able to remove chairs with a hmmer inside houses of Avoleke village.
 Some localization fixes.


❤️ If you enjoy the game so far, please don't forget to leave a review.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
We are thankful for your valuable feedback and want to address some of the most important points in this small patch. More adjustments will follow in the future!


Deers, rabbits, jackalopes and penguins now respawn.
Penguins always loot animal fat.
Fixed that Tara Brown can be killed if you talked to the Brown brothers before (quest).

notes.title: Release Cover Art Reveal!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/663fa638234bde6cdfe6adeb48a093bb6b56abf0.png

Video Version

[previewyoutube=KYOate8HqHY;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone, 

My name is Tobi and I am the lead developer of the team behind Above Snakes. Today, I want to talk to you about the portrayal of our main character, Aiyana, and the exciting update we have given her! We wanted to take a moment to go in depth about why we chose certain design elements for this rework and why it was important to do so.

First and foremost, we want to say that we still love the original design of Aiyana. However, over the past two years, we have noticed that she is often mistaken as a fully native character when, in actuality, Aiyana is an individual that represents both the tribes of Above Snakes and its colonists. Aiyana's father descends from a tribe while her mother is a colonist from Corpse Creek (that’s all we can say without spoiling anything). As we are nearing the eventual full release of Above Snakes, it felt more important than ever to capture the essence of both in Aiyana’s design. 

Additionally, we were made aware that the original art featured some historical inaccuracies in Aiyana’s portrayal. We aimed to correct those errors. Despite Above Snakes being a work of fiction and fantasy, some design choices broke the illusion of a believable world as it didn’t properly represent the whole of Aiyana’s character or background. We are happy to say that we did our very best to amend these concerns and to better portray Aiyana as she truly is.

For the new artwork, we worked closely with Native American fans and volunteers who were kind enough to offer insight about how to best express Aiyana’s background and how to tease the larger story of Above Snakes. 

We want to offer a big thank you to the Native American gaming community for assisting and consulting with us during this exciting process! A lot of thought and hard work went into this new design. We also want to thank Lyubov Kolodeznikova for bringing this vision to life in such a beautiful way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/6f7bab1eaf880659335cfbb81af3165890ea77e1.png
Full Artwork by Lyubov Kolodeznikova

Since we collectively put a great deal of thought and research into this new design, we want to highlight some key elements. Please keep in mind that, despite Above Snakes being a fantasy world, the game borrows heavily from the history of the American Wild West.

Firstly, we decided to stay away from feathers. Originally, we utilized feathers on Aiyana’s tomahawk and her bow but, historically, eagle feathers were considered to be a man's item.

Aiyana's dress is now a basic two-hide dress. The cream white color - due to the lack of heavily smoking the leather - are typical for Native American dresses from that period. Additionally, the dress is not heavily fringed on the sleeves. This style of dress could be anything from the northwest, Great Basin, the Great Plains, Great Lakes, and even representative of southwest cultures like the Jicarilla and Lipan Apache.

Aiyana is wearing white shell earrings that were common among many men and women west of the Mississippi River. They could be whelk shell from the southeast, wampum from the northeast, clam from the northwest, or pink concho (which is mostly white). In the southwest, it was common for men to wear headbands, but this was not a common practice for women. Therefore, we removed the headband.

Another key element to Aiyana’s updated look is her belt which would usually feature three items: a knife, a fire steel striker, and an awl. These were commonly found in historical depictions of Native American characters. In the case of Aiyana, we chose to go with a tomahawk to showcase her survival abilities - both for daily necessity and for fighting, if needed. The tomahawk was widely used by Native American tribes and is a symbol of both strength and skill.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/1f1217df4c0a5091107d3c4ff928f31e180dccbf.png
Selection of used references.

Aiyana’s leather hat is an inheritance from her colonist mother. One of the most interesting details we’ve implemented into her new look is the change to Aiyana's initial black hair. Dark brown-black hair is a typical attribute for Native women, but since Aiyana’s mother is a colonist, we painted the tips of her hair a lighter color, almost blondish. The blonder tips typically appear in women of mixed backgrounds - yet another subtle nod to our protagonist’s heritage. 

We decided against the more traditional Native American braid for Aiyana and instead went a slightly different route. Aiyana now wears her hair in some braids (not historically accurate) with looser hairs to again represent both sides of her family.

Aiyana's props were reworked to better reflect the materials available at the time, along with appropriate bead patterns. Even though backpacks were not exactly a thing, we imagined what a backpack could have looked like by taking inspiration from different handbags.

In summary, we put a great deal of thought and care into updating Aiyana’s design to better represent her background and show a greater respect to the inspirations that help breathe life into the world of Above Snakes. We hope you enjoy her new look as much as we all enjoyed creating it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/e6601161c041374a987ada6d44012e432b3f86f3.png
Steam Cover Art

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/6a46329373d5b2417755ca1a1b511735f8ee27f7.png
Alternative Artwork

Please note that we will not be removing the old design associated with the game. We love and celebrate our initial rendition of Aiyana and will simply refer to that design as "Alpha Artwork." We want to encourage content creators, media, and fans to use the new design going forward when showcasing Above Snakes content.

Let us know your thoughts below! As always, thank you for following along on this incredible journey.

Cheers,
Tobi

notes.title: 🏡 Devlog #8 - Beta Release Date!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/92e206a3eb53b64ce933addaeac73dbfcf57efe1.png

Howdy Adventurers!
We hope you are having a wonderful holiday season and are ready for some exciting news from the world of Above Snakes. Firstly, we are changing our devlog format a little bit. This new format will be a blend of both written information and videos rather than showcasing one big video. In this specific devlog, one of the key features we're developing - base building improvements - gets its own special video. This mix will allow us to go in-depth into one feature per devlog. Let us know if you enjoy this format!

Base Building Improvements
We've made some terrific improvements regarding our base building system, most notably by adding more gameplay value. To do this, we've attached a shelter system to the base fundamentals that provides shelter perks per level. This will encourage deeper gameplay when considering building a better (and stronger) shelter. Keep in mind that this system focuses on the quality of your shelter, not necessarily how grand or big it is. 

Shelter perks, for instance, will include fortified walls that provide greater safety from outside elements, better soil for quicker crops,  improved crafting stations that will operate more efficiently, and deeper wells which can offer more water.

Watch the video on our improvements to the base building system:
[previewyoutube=n6d-k9n7ba0;full][/previewyoutube]
 
Pssst..for more updates, don't forget to subscribe to our YouTube Channel.

Merchants & Currency
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/88d268e7a7a482599f94dfcdf607d529f1fbebac.png

A new currency has been added to the game: coins! Coins can be looted during your ventures and used later on for supplies and trade. We've also added junk items with their sole purpose of being sold to traders along the way. Our goal is to add more Wild West flavor to the game by implementing objects such as horseshoes, a deck of cards, pocket watches, and more! Let us know what you would like to find when looting.

In addition to junk items, we've also added traders to the game. Traders will offer various kinds of goods and are happy to pay for some items you may not necessarily need. Keep in mind that traders may sometimes have discounts or price hikes. 

Conversation Update
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/a6400ee3e9d7d467ac9a7cb11fbff13a83662a8d.png 
 
Conversations with characters are a significant part of Above Snakes. We're proud to have updated the conservation system which will now feature sound mid-conversation. These sounds may reflect items being given to Aiyana or its payment.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40278000/8a8acfb164c91693f89287407864ef03e68c227c.png
Additionally, we've updated nearly every character's portrait! As you can see, we've transitioned from grayscale portraiture to more detailed and colorful depictions of the characters you'll come across in Above Snakes.

In Other News
The Square Glade Games team has determined that running closed tests from time to time is a good way to playtest a game. In addition to gaining priceless feedback, the team can decide if we're on the right track or not. If you would like to be a part of any future closed tests, be sure to sign up on our new company website. If you've already enrolled on our old website, don't worry! We saved your data.

We also were happy to showcase Above Snakes at DevGAMM Game Fest! We even did a short interview which you can watch below.

[previewyoutube=7V1yxTy0mag;full][/previewyoutube]
 
The Beta Will Release December 16th 
We couldn’t be happier to announce that we're ready to transition into Beta on December 16th! That means that all of the backers who backed for “Beta Access - 27€” will receive their game key! According to the Kickstarter roadmap, we are well on track with our progress. We're happy that we get to celebrate this important step together! Eligible Kickstarter backers will receive an email containing their game key(s) on December 16th (around 10am PST).

For supporters who have already received a key as a result of Alpha access, start up Above Snakes like normal on Steam and install the update to Beta status on December 16th. We will inform you all in a separate update that the Beta keys have been sent!

We hope that you enjoyed this devlog as much as we have enjoyed implementing all of this new content. We look forward to stepping into Beta together. Thank you to everyone for your support. We can’t wait to see you play the Above Snakes Beta and hear your opinions on it!

Cheers,
Tobi
